transport.android_binder_sample: AIDL service/client sample proxying the semantic gateway
transport.android_console_path: debug APK binds CentralBrainGatewayBinderService before invoking /uib/state and /agent/plan; execute/skills/memory are Binder contract samples

endpoints.description: Returns system, service bus, and AI backend health.
Returns registered prototype services and capabilities.
Returns Uni Info Bus Context envelope for vehicle, user, and environment.
Architecture-aligned alias for Uni Info Bus Context.
Returns Uni Info Bus State envelope for system, services, NPU, vehicle, and safety state.
Architecture-aligned alias for Uni Info Bus State.
Compatibility endpoint for Uni Info Bus event topics.
Compatibility endpoint for publishing a mock Uni Info Bus event.
Returns Uni Info Bus Event topic contract, delivery model, and binding candidates.
Publishes a bounded-log mock event through the Uni Info Bus Event semantic envelope.
Returns recent Uni Info Bus Event records from the active mock log.
Compatibility endpoint for submitting a policy-checked mock Action request.
Architecture-aligned Uni Info Bus Action entry that applies Permission and Safety State checks without dispatching real Driver/HAL or vehicle bus control.
Invokes a mock service through the Uni Info Bus service method entry.
Returns SOA service entries with contract, permissions, safety state, and runtime registration metadata.
Architecture-aligned SOA service entry that applies mock Permission, Safety State, Lifecycle, and QoS checks before dispatch.
Returns Runtime & Governance state for Registry, Discovery, Schema, active fixed-window QoS, Policy, Lifecycle, and Audit.
Architecture-aligned Policy entry for Permission and Safety State checks.
Returns recent Runtime & Governance audit records created by SOA calls; optional JSONL persistence is enabled by CENTRAL_BRAIN_AUDIT_LOG.
Returns Protocol Binding status for active REST, Android Binder/AIDL skeleton, Linux IPC/gRPC skeleton, and planned MQTT/SOME-IP/DDS paths.
Returns Protocol Binding contract artifacts for Android Binder/AIDL, Android system service integration notes, Linux IPC, and Linux gRPC skeletons.
Returns Native adapter registry for AIOS Kernel, SOA Service Adapter, Vehicle Signal Adapter, Model Runtime Adapter, and Security/Policy Adapter.
Returns Native adapter integration constraints, Android primary path, Linux sync path, and driver/HAL dependency notes.
Returns mock Tool schemas for AI tool calls.
Returns AI SDK facade capabilities and the Android/Linux task planning, execute, Skill, and Memory delivery paths.
Compatibility alias for Policy evaluation during Action/Tool/Service calls.
Returns mock vehicle state with VSS-style signal names.
Returns external PCIe NPU runtime and discovery status.
Submits a mock inference request.
Converts a user intent or scene trigger into a policy-aware task graph whose executable steps must route through Uni Info Bus, Tool, Action, or SOA entries.
Validates a policy-approved task graph and returns execution dispatch boundaries without calling real Skill runtime, Model Runtime Adapter, Driver/HAL, vehicle bus, or virtualization.
Returns built-in Skill manifests with sandbox, permissions, Safety State, and semantic entry constraints.
Invokes a sandbox-contract mock Skill after Policy/Safety State evaluation and records audit without direct Driver/HAL or vehicle bus dispatch.
Queries local-only mock vehicle/user memory for task context after Policy/Safety State evaluation; no cloud sync or memory write occurs.
Planned: decides whether data can leave the vehicle and what redaction is required.
